abstract: Builds a one-page pre-call cheatsheet from the client folder (profile, state log, the last CallFacts block, the newest outreach, an optional CRM row and, when connected, Wispr Flow meeting titles): who, where we stand, open threads, goals, questions, pivots and one next step, in the client's language and register with Hebrew as the default. Writes only clients/<client-name>/cheatsheet-<date>-<HHMM>.md and never overwrites.
